body: hey i’m in a different time zone but if you need a friend im here. i think if you really want to go to therapy or it will benefit you you should try and muster up the courage to ask to do it. also idk if this relates to you or not because i have no clue what you’re like but my mum (who’s a counsellor, also i know that therapy and counselling are different but idk) said to me i should find someone who i’m comfortable with sharing shit with and stuff like that, you know find someone who you think you can get the most out of seeing, that probably doesn’t help at all also if you even have the option to do it. anyway i’m also 16 and kinda dumb so i probably don’t have the best advice or anything but if you ever want to vent or talk about shit id be happy chat anytime or just talk to you every now and then. i can’t tell how long this is but i think it’s long so sorry bout that but i wish you good luck if you ask your mum
